comparison.objective: Start a hand tap, reverse it to break the chip, and avoid snapping it versus tune and lock damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized two-hand wrench rotation with balanced axial loading versus one-tool setscrew work, cylindrical counterhold, fine collar adjustment, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Quarter-turn inward, tenth-turn reverse, no lateral breakage, then release versus two safe impact cycles and low post-lock drift.
comparison.reason: Both require controlled rotation, but the tap task tests balanced thread cutting and reversal, while the candidate tests calibration and retained adjustment.
